 Persebaya vs Java United: Bajol Ijo Must Bounce Back, Visitors Arrive After Toppling Persib!
 Persebaya Surabaya faces Java United in the tenth week of the BRI Super League at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium with a determination to bounce back.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Hanif Ramadhan 
 November 20, 2026 at 11:35 AM WITA ·
 6 min read
 Photo caption: Archive of the Persebaya Surabaya match against Malut United (now Java United) at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Surabaya, January 17, 2025. (Photo: Persebaya) 
 SURABAYA, Aktualita.co -  The Persebaya vs Java United match is predicted to be intense when the two teams meet in the 10th week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Surabaya, on Saturday (November 21, 2026), at 15:30 WIB or 16:30 WITA. 
 Persebaya Surabaya faces a tough challenge to return to winning ways after going through several matches with unsatisfactory results. Meanwhile, Java United FC arrives with high confidence after successfully defeating Persib Bandung.

 This match is an important opportunity for both teams to improve their positions in the provisional standings. Persebaya and Java United both have 13 points from nine matches. 
 Java United is in seventh place, while Persebaya occupies the eighth position. Goal productivity difference is one of the factors placing the visitors above Bajol Ijo . 
 With that condition, a victory will have great significance for both teams in the race toward the top of the table. 
 Persebaya Strives to Bounce Back After Defeat to Persija 
 Persebaya enters this home match with significant homework to do. 
 In the last BRI Super League match before the international break, the team coached by Bernardo Tavares had to acknowledge Persija Jakarta's superiority with a 0-1 score at the Jakarta International Stadium on Saturday (November 7, 2026). 
 Previously, Persebaya was also only able to play to a 1-1 draw against Persijap Jepara at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium on October 30, 2026. 
 From their last five league matches, Bajol Ijo recorded one win, two draws, and two losses. These results show that Persebaya still needs consistency, especially when facing teams with solid organizational play. 
 Nevertheless, Persebaya received a confidence boost after winning an international friendly match against the Western Australia Football Team with a score of 4-3 on Sunday (November 15, 2026). 
 The match served as an opportunity for the coaching staff to evaluate play while giving playing time to several players who had just recovered from injuries. 
 Alfan Suaib Recovers, Matheus Lagoa Ready to Add Strength 
 One piece of positive news ahead of the Persebaya vs Java United match is the progress of Alfan Suaib's condition. 
 The 22-year-old winger is nearing his best condition after being sidelined for quite a long time due to injury. 
 Alfan even managed to score one goal when Persebaya faced the Western Australia Football Team. 
 "Currently, my condition is improving and I feel more ready to play. However, everything remains the coach's decision. I will continue to work hard in training and am ready to give my best if I get the chance," said Alfan Suaib, a Persebaya winger. 
 Alfan's return has the potential to add options for Bernardo Tavares on the wing. His speed and ability to open up space could be an alternative for facing Java United's defense. 
 In addition to Alfan, Persebaya also received a boost from Matheus Lagoa. 
 The attacking midfielder from Brazil has started to show his quality after recovering from injury. In the match against Western Australia, Lagoa contributed one assist for Alex Martins' goal. 
 Lagoa admitted he has started studying Java United's playing style to help Persebaya perform more effectively. 
 "My focus right now is entirely on the match against Java United. I am trying to study the opponent's weaknesses so we can take good advantage of them when attacking," said Matheus Lagoa, a Persebaya midfielder. 
 Nevertheless, the decision regarding which players start from the first minute remains dependent on the coach's assessment of physical readiness and tactical needs. 
 Java United Arrives with Momentum from Victory over Persib 
 Java United is not an opponent to be taken lightly. The team nicknamed Laskar Kepodang Emas has shown positive progress in the last few matches. 
 In the ninth week, Java United managed to defeat Persib Bandung with a score of 2-1 at Jatidiri Stadium, Semarang, on Sunday (November 8, 2026). 
 The two winning goals for Java United were scored by Ciro Alves and Gustavo Franca, while Persib replied through B. Sekulic. 
 The victory extended the positive record of Fabio Lefundes' team, which is unbeaten in the last five league matches with three wins and two draws. 
 Java United coach, Fabio Lefundes, previously appreciated his players' hard work after successfully overcoming Persib's resistance. 
 "We knew it was a difficult match because of the quality of the opponent's players. Indeed, they have quality. But our defense also played consistently even though we conceded," said Fabio Lefundes, Java United coach, after the match against Persib. 
 Java United has a number of experienced players, including Ciro Alves, David da Silva, Yakob Sayuri, Yance Sayuri, and Kei Hirose. 
 The combination of these players provides variety in play, both through attacks from the flanks and finishing in front of the goal. 
 For information, Java United is the continuation of Malut United FC. The club's name change was ratified at the PSSI Ordinary Congress on August 3, 2026, simultaneously marking the club's identity shift to Central Java. 
 Head to Head Persebaya vs Java United 
 Based on competition operator records, Persebaya has a fairly good record in the last four meetings against Java United, including when the club was still using the Malut United identity. 
 Here are the results of the last four meetings between the two teams: 
 April 23, 2026: Java United 0-2 Persebaya 
 January 10, 2026: Persebaya 2-1 Java United 
 January 17, 2025: Persebaya 0-2 Java United 
 August 16, 2024: Java United 0-0 Persebaya 
 From those four matches, Persebaya achieved two wins, Java United one win, and one other match ended in a draw. 
 Persebaya's two consecutive wins in the most recent meetings provide a psychological boost for Bajol Ijo. 
 However, meeting records do not always reflect current strength. Java United arrives with more stable performance, while Persebaya is trying to rediscover its consistency. 
 Gelora Bung Tomo North Stand Closed 
 There is also important information for Bonek and Bonita who plan to watch the match in person. 
 The Persebaya organizing committee decided to close the north stand of Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium starting from the match against Java United. 
 Persebaya Organizing Committee Chairman, Ram Surahman, explained that the decision was taken based on security and comfort evaluations during home match hosting. 
 "For the sake of mutual security and comfort, we were forced to make this decision after conducting an internal evaluation regarding the hosting of home matches," explained Ram Surahman, Persebaya Organizing Committee Chairman. 
 The committee asks supporters to follow the official ticket purchase provisions and maintain order while in the stadium. 
 Schedule and Live Broadcast of Persebaya vs Java United 
 The match between Persebaya and Java United is scheduled to take place with the following details: 
 Competition: BRI Super League 2026/2027, 10th week 
 Match: Persebaya Surabaya vs Java United FC 
 Day/date: Saturday, November 21, 2026 
 Kick-off: 15:30 WIB / 16:30 WITA 
 Stadium: Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya 
 Live broadcast: Indosiar, according to the competition operator's schedule. 
 This match is expected to be tight considering both teams have the same number of points. Persebaya has the advantage of playing at home and being supported by fans, while Java United brings positive momentum from the previous match. 
 The midfield battle, effectiveness in finishing, and the ability to anticipate counter-attacks have the potential to be the deciding factors. 
 For Persebaya, three points will be an important step to get back closer to the top-tier competition. Conversely, a victory for Java United will strengthen their position while maintaining their positive trend in the BRI Super League this season.
